propositions: Event logs grow unbounded after compaction was removed from the close path to fix a 13m53s lock hold, leaving stores with no standing trigger unless CI-based scheduling exists.
The two-arm selection rejects tickets that backfill but never re-fold: selecting only on foldable count over threshold misses the backfill case where the ticket is small and has no snapshot yet.
A sweep that walks git history per ticket inside the write lock recreates bug 7084 at ticket scale: tens of minutes to hours of O(history) walks across thousands of tickets, all lock-held.
An operation-linked fallback trigger spawned from the close path after lock release, using a stamped advisory lock and a detached worker, enables compaction in environments with no CI and no cron.
The sweep is safe to run after the operator fix: one history walk per sweep hoisted out of the lock, with scoped git staging and re-yield of the lock between chunks.
